name: sc-meta-skill
description: Author cross-harness marketplace plugins with explicit dependency contracts and a dated harness-capability matrix.

interface.shortDescription: Author cross-harness plugins with dependency contracts.
interface.longDescription: Source of truth for building marketplace plugins for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Declares the D1-D5 dependency model (skill, agent, artifact, binding, harness capability) and a dated harness-capability matrix so plugins never hardcode a stale harness assumption.
defaultPrompt: Use marketplace-plugin-authoring to author a cross-harness marketplace plugin.
